description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerOptionDao interface, providing database access methods for CustomerOption entities, including listing by store, retrieving by ID or code, and save or update operations.

classes.name: CustomerOptionDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access object for CustomerOption, extending generic DAO and providing custom query methods.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptions associated with a specific MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOption by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOption by its code within a specific store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOption or updates an existing one, depending on whether the ID is set.
